decisions.statement: Apple reads this over https and follows no redirect, so a route answers it.
The address ends in no extension, so the answer is what names itself application/json.
This route is reached without a session, because Apple carries none.
One app id is named, the team joined to the bundle the ios-app page states.
One path opens the app, so every other address on this site stays in the browser that opened it.
Web credentials are declared before any passkey exists.

definition: what Apple reads before it lets a link or a passkey reach the app
